farfoldImplemented: Only official copying of current complete context. Historical-point capability, message-bound point representation, shared UI action and fork request parameter are absent.

officialGooseScope.forkCutoff: Official ACP conversationBefore passes an integer timestamp; truncate removes messages with created_timestamp >= cutoff.
officialGooseScope.precisionBoundary: New message constructors use second-resolution timestamps; timestamp-only cutoff cannot distinguish arbitrary same-time message nodes. A different internal database helper is not an exposed ACP operation.

runtimeUiObservation.sample: Current assistant message extension-fields detail exposes official goose.created and goose.messageId.
runtimeUiObservation.boundary: Latest retained fields are not a validated node selector. No proof of live/replay ID identity, native-row mapping or exact fork is claimed.

requiredImplementationBoundary: Any implementation must obtain official point metadata with the corresponding message in acp_client, retain raw envelopes, expose only verified capabilities to shared UI, and preserve existing ownership/unknown-outcome safeguards. Local display time, fabricated IDs and a new persistent event/locator ledger are not substitutes.

officialCodexScope.airV1Semantics: Official messageId resolves to its containing completed turn; inclusive whole-turn fork, not arbitrary within-turn cutoff.
officialCodexScope.currentSupportLimit: Ordinary fork:{} advertisement and reviewed official launch shape do not confirm adoption of this request metadata. Current-copy success can be indistinguishable from ignored metadata; response and visible replay do not provide a complete cutoff proof.
officialCodexScope.hostGap: Existing raw events/projection preserve official messageId, but capability/selected-item/request wiring remains absent. Unknown point semantics stay unavailable; no unsafe probe, invented echo, version pin or binary-hash gate is added.
